# klaviyo_segment (Resource)

A Klaviyo audience segment. The `definition` attribute carries the full SegmentDefinition JSON blob; build the segment in Klaviyo's UI, export it, and embed via `file()` or `jsonencode()`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    klaviyo = { source = "aroma-zone/klaviyo", version = "~> 0.1" }
  }
}
provider "klaviyo" {}

resource "klaviyo_segment" "vips" {
  name       = "VIP Customers"
  definition = file("${path.module}/vip_segment.json")
  is_starred = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `definition` (String) SegmentDefinition JSON. Whitespace-only differences do not produce diffs.
- `name` (String) Human-readable segment name.

### Optional

- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the segment is active. Setting to false deactivates the segment.
- `is_starred` (Boolean) Whether the segment is starred (highlighted in the Klaviyo UI). Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) ISO-8601 timestamp the segment was created (server-assigned).
- `id` (String) Klaviyo-assigned identifier.
- `is_processing` (Boolean) Server-assigned: true while Klaviyo is recomputing the segment membership.
- `updated` (String) ISO-8601 timestamp the segment was last updated (server-assigned).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
terraform import klaviyo_segment.vips <segment-id>
```
